**D. glycolysis is activated at the onset of exercise.** Lactate production rises when glycolytic flux surges and pyruvate is produced faster than the mitochondria can oxidise it. A falling pH is a consequence of lactate and H⁺ accumulation, and it tends to inhibit glycolysis rather than drive lactate production. Oxygen availability lowers lactate production, and pyruvate is the substrate for lactate, so it has to be formed. My earlier answer of C was likely wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 66
